events.summary: Jhoira modifies ancient Thran cannons to fire pure Shivan lava.
events.quote: To conserve ammunition, Jhoira modified ancient Thran artillery cannons to fire gouts of pure Shivan lava.

events.summary: Tolaria falls to the Phyrexians and students flee with their research.
events.quote: Students fled with their research as Tolaria fell to the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Karn calls a lockdown because anyone could be compromised by Phyrexians.
events.quote: "No one leaves until we know who can be trusted."

events.summary: Jhoira pays Talas pirates twice what they could steal to spy for her.
events.quote: "The Talas pirates are motivated by money, so we paid them twice what they could steal from us to spy for us instead." —Jhoira

events.summary: Danitha sees Jaya blast charging Phyrexians with lightning.
events.quote: Danitha watched in shock as electricity lanced from Jaya's fingertips, obliterating the charging Phyrexians.

events.summary: Jaya accepts that she may die for Dominaria.
events.quote: Jaya did not want to die, but of all the things to die for, Dominaria felt right.

events.summary: The Society of Mishra takes control of the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam.
events.quote: Once the Society of Mishra took control, the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam became a haven for dark research.

events.summary: Tinybones pulls off the greatest heist of all time.
events.quote: To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.

events.summary: Squee orders his troops to attack the squishy parts.
events.quote: Squee's orders basically came down to "attack the squishy parts."

events.summary: Radha declares she is coming for Sheoldred.
events.quote: "Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"

events.summary: Jaya and Jodah agree to more fire against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: "More fire?" Jaya asked. "More fire," Jodah agreed.

relations.note: Aron looks like Danitha's father but the man she knew is gone
relations.quote: "He may look like my father, but the man I knew and loved is gone." —Danitha
"Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of *compleation*."
"More fire?" Jaya asked. "More fire," Jodah agreed.

relations.note: Shanna grew up hearing Sisay's legend
relations.quote: Shanna had heard Sisay's legend all her life.

relations.note: The Coalition rises against the invading tide
relations.quote: The Coalition was more than just treaties and alliances: it was the soul of a world rising up against the invading tide.
